0x00056C:
A giant hibernation facility of Project Ark, the <EOT Special Council>'s species preservation plan, built underground in Kenya, Africa. It is run by Magus, an autonomous supercomputer by Dr. Sophia Nate. Thousands were to sleep through the Aerogater invasion, but the <DC War> halted construction.
After the war, DC remnants used it as a base until the Kurogane's crew wrecked it; it is now under a Federation research institute. A twin 'Moon Cradle' exists on the Moon.
0x000F14:
Grotesque beings that appeared in the Earth Sphere in New Era 187-188. Their main force, the Einst series, were enigmatic living weapons that at first waged inexplicable localized battles. Only the high-ranking Einst Regisseur and a girl named Alfimi showed clear will; their society resembled bees or ants.
The Einst long existed in another dimension (Einst space), watching the real world's intelligent life. To silence endlessly warring humanity and create a new intelligent species, they tried to join Einst space to the real world and invade it.
They fought the Hagane, Kurogane, and Hiryu Custom repeatedly. In the final battle Neu Regisseur fused with the White Star into the colossal Stern Neu Regisseur but fell; the remaining Einst then vanished.
0x001BA1: A high-level Federation body handling secrets on Meteor 3 and the Aerogaters: 13 core members of the Federation Security Council, ranking above the <EOTI Organization>. Chaired by Karl Stresemann. Knowing the Aerogaters' might from Meteor 3 and <EOT> studies, it deemed Bian's resistance stance dangerous and obstructed him - one factor in the <DC> revolt. All members died in the L5 Campaign, ending it.
0x002A98: %A device fitted to certain <T-LINK System>-equipped machines. Officially a T-LINK auxiliary, it activates forcibly under set conditions, taking over telekinetic devices, machine control, fire control and output. It briefly exceeds catalog specs while badly straining pilot and machine. Called 'a system for inducing hysterical strength,' its details are known only to a few in the <SRX Project>. One theory credits ex-project head Ingram Prisken, an Aerogater agent; its black-boxed core defies even T-LINK developer Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi.
0x0034D6: Develops assault-type humanoid mobile weapons. Twin pillar to the <SRX Project>, it builds machines largely forgoing <EOT>, per head Dr. Marion Radom. Once aimed at the next Federation mainline unit, it now makes custom machines for aces.
0x003B88: Conflict the Aerogaters caused after the <DC> War in New Era 187. From Neviim (codename: White Star), an automated planetoid that appeared at L5, they raided the Earth Sphere with insectoid mobile weapons like the Megillot. Impressed by human combat skill, they schemed to make humans their own soldiers, but lost the final battle, Operation SRW. They proved to be humans mentally conditioned by an unknown party - a strict secret.
0x004EEB: A parallel-world group, via the transfer device 'System XN.' Once that world's Federation special-ops unit, after the <L5 Campaign> they backed the DC remnants' uprising to perfect System XN and prolong war via mass-produced units and 'W Series' androids, but fell to the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
0x0064BD: The Earth Federation's international military, built from the old-era UN Special Forces. It alone is unified globally, though each regional army keeps traits of the national forces it grew from.
0x0073E7:
A telekinesis sensing and amplification device by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi of the <SRX Project>. It extracts 'T-Alpha Pulses,' deep brainwaves governing thought, to control objects' motion and assist in piloting mobile weapons. It can also generate a Telekinetic Field, usable as a barrier or a ram. Amplified thought widens the user's sixth-sense-like perception, aiding enemy detection.
The system depends on the user's mental state, though, and excessive linkage strains the brain. Those whose T-Alpha Pulses exceed a set level are called 'Psychodrivers.'
0x0086D2: A deep brainwave governing thought, proposed by Dr. Kenzo Kobayashi. Gauges Psychodriver aptitude.
0x00919B: A revolt in New Era 186 at the Federation Army's Coatsland Base, Antarctica. The base was unveiling the Shirogane, first Space Noah-class carrier, and the Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon from the <EOTI Organization> - camouflage for secret peace talks with extraterrestrials codenamed the 'Guests.' The terms amounted to near-total capitulation, angering many who knew. During the talks Dr. Shu Shirakawa, Granzon developer and test pilot, suddenly attacked the Guests' craft, then the Federation forces, wrecking the base. Talks collapsed, and the <DC> soon rose up, triggering the wars that followed (the <DC War>, <L5 Campaign>, and <Inspector Incident>). As the Guests arrived in an <Aerogaters> ship, many equated the two; since the <Inspector Incident> the prevailing view is that the ship was a decoy and the Guests are a force tied to the <Inspectors>.
0x009FAE: Pilots of humanoid mobile weapons raised at the <School>. Kinless children with keen reflexes and dynamic vision got mind control, drugs and harsh training. Memories were erased; severe <Limacon> broke many minds. Arado, Seolla, and Latooni are among the few survivors.
0x00AAFB: XA heavy machinery maker Tin Mao founded in New Era 176 with Yuan Meilun in the lunar city Celevis. It first built lunar work machines but now mainly makes Personal Troopers. President: Tin's daughter Ring Mao.
0x00B2E8: A meteorite that fell in New Era 179 on Aidoneus Island in the South Pacific. <EOTI Organization> studies suggest the Aerogaters sent it deliberately: it appeared suddenly at L5, decelerated on its own before impact, and held <EOT> sealed inside, packaged for study. Named after 'Meteor 1' and 'Meteor 2,' Old Era meteorites that struck New York and Moscow and gravely set back Earth's civilization.
0x00BCA6: The ReEOTH PLAN. ReEOTH ('Laios') stands for 'Reliable Extra Over Technological Hybrid' - alien technology made highly dependable. It reworks the unstable <EOT>, raising reliability and stability with Earth's latest technology. Beyond upgrading existing EOT-equipped machines, it aims to bring ReEOTH into R-Series successors and future mass-production units.
